review: Independent source and host-contract review of the finite native screenshot PNG profile

publication_context.verification_scope: The publishing worker reported this head. This reviewer independently verified the local source tree, not the remote ref.

source_scope.unchanged: Application and installed-test source, receipt/source binding, archive hashes and extraction checks are outside this three-file delta.

chunk_grammar.result: Every observed acceptance or rejection matched the independent grammar oracle.

independent_checks.source_and_documentation_review: Finite RGB8/RGBA8 profile, supported metadata lengths/values/order/uniqueness, header/end grammar, CRCs, bounded exact zlib completion and scanline envelope reviewed. Unsupported formats fail explicitly; documentation retains separate decoder and visual review.

limits: This is a bounded native screenshot profile, not general PNG conformance or a universal Android output guarantee.
The grammar enumeration covers token lengths one through six; it is not an exhaustive proof over unbounded inputs.
The capture check establishes byte-preserving compatibility with previously accepted captures, not a fresh installed run.
No Android compilation, emulator execution, native rendering or visual/input acceptance was performed by this review.
Full host aggregate results are recorded separately; the reviewer did not rerun those aggregates.
No repository source was modified and no remote publication was performed by this reviewer.
